top_signals.title: Taiwan’s Currency Rebounds After Weakening Past 33 Per US Dollar
top_signals.summary: The Taiwan dollar rebounded after weakening past 33 per US dollar on Friday, with analysts citing official efforts to calm a stock rout and speculation that policymakers moved to steady the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Soaring fuel costs hit profit at British Airways owner IAG
top_signals.summary: British Airways owner IAG has taken a hit to its profit due to “very high” jet fuel prices, which industry bosses have warned could force some airlines into collapse next year.
